items.title: Hotel without air conditioning, food in bad condition, terrible solutions... in short.... A horror movie
items.review_text: The hotel is a disaster, the air conditioning doesn't work even in the rooms, the food is horrible (lack of refrigeration, little variety, cold coffee and warm juices, not to mention that there is no air conditioning and that the restaurant is also full of flies, a disaster) in addition to the fact that they cannot agree on how to tell lies, since the night before I reported that the air conditioning was not working, in the morning I get up and go to the public relations department to complain after having contacted my agency, everyone at the hotel knew that the air conditioning was not working, and while sitting there they called from my agency to the front desk to ask if it was true that they had climate control problems to which the receptionist stated that the climate control was working perfectly, then I receive the message from the travel agency telling me this and while sitting there I confront them and they tell me that the receptionist did not have that information, which she clearly did have since she made a key for me the day before to see another room that had the same problem, it is a disaster as a hotel and honestly they should coordinate better to tell lies, but mainly they should stop playing with the guests' departures, it is preferable that they tell the guest that they have broken equipment or whatever and that they should go to another hotel, rather than having them wait like a fool there and laughing at them..... Just to highlight something, Carlos who brings room service is very kind, as is the maintenance guy, and the cleaning ladies who assisted me were more than pleasant, it is the only good thing I take away from that hotel, I hope they know how to value the staff they have more, instead of having them working in subhuman conditions….. one last thing to highlight, they brought me a fan at the last minute so it would blow air on me ….. a shame that they cut the electricity every 5 min …. I find the solution pathetic….

items.title: Automatic energy backup system and the best place with Wi-Fi connection I have ever been to.
items.review_text: I spent two nights from Saturday to Monday (7/18-20), and the truth is I found it very good. I was able to enjoy all the included benefits of the Meliá Rewards loyalty program, with early check-in and late check-out, and the welcome drink. If you are looking for an ideal place to rest, this is the one, as it has a very good energy backup system, it is automatic. I went with my children who loved it, they have lagoons with very beautiful fish that entertain the children. As a benefit of the place where it is located and which for me was decisive in booking it, is that it has the National Aquarium with the Festival Pa' Cuba just a few blocks away, and you can walk there. To my joy I found my English professor Orlando from the university, who was very cordial and always very concerned about the well-being of the guests. The room was clean, the TV channels could be seen well and the signal did not drop, they restock you with towels and whatever you need. The Wi-Fi connection is great. I managed to reach up to 42 Mbps connection, something never seen in any of the hotels I have been to or anywhere in Cuba. This has been the place with the best Wi-Fi connection speed. I give it 4 stars because the pool really needs renovation, and I hope that the renovation being done on the top floors soon reaches the pool as well.

items.title: An exceptional hotel worthy of a visit and a stay.
items.review_text: This is a hotel worth visiting and spending a pleasant stay at; the facilities are impeccable, the restaurants offer five-star service, the maids leave the rooms sparkling, and all the staff provide attentive service at the reception. The treatment is incredible; they make you feel like family all the time. Amparo at the reception was very attentive, always aware of all our needs, and with a smile, she was always ready to ensure we had a great stay. I would definitely return to this hotel; thank you for the five-star service.

items.title: Incredible experience in Havana
items.review_text:
I stayed 2 nights in the hotel with a group of friends and was amazing the structure of the hotel. There is a boulevard with several restaurants, a cigar shop, a cafeteria, a garden that gives the impression that we are in a park. Beautiful.
Besides the pool which is huge, clean, with a wet bar and overlooking the sea. 
The hotel is further away from the historic center but is in a super quiet region and close to a street where there are several bars/restaurants.
Manager Negrin is always present to ensure everything is perfect and is a loved one.
The manha cafe is full and the attendants are kind.  
The apartments are spacious, clean, have coffee in capsule, sea view. Top!
I'd definitely come back.

items.title: The Privilege of Feeling at Home
items.review_text:
There is a very specific form of luxury that does not relate to the shine of materials, but to memory and consistency. Returning to the Meliá Habana year after year is to experience that relief of knowing that, upon crossing its doors, everything will be exactly where it should be.
What defines a "home" away from home is the staff. It is not just the efficiency in check-in or the cleanliness of the service; it is the feeling that your presence is valued. In an environment where everything changes, finding that technical and human hospitality that welcomes you with the same level of professionalism year after year is a rare luxury. It is a place where you are not just a room number, but a returning resident.
The Meliá Habana does not try to be the trendiest or the most avant-garde hotel; I feel it prefers to be the most welcoming. It is the refuge for the professional seeking efficiency and for the traveler seeking peace. After so many years, it continues to demonstrate that true supremacy lies not in novelty, but in sustained excellence over time.
It is, without a doubt, the place where Havana becomes predictable in the best sense: that of absolute comfort.

responses.title: Frederik Andersen
responses.text:
Muchas gracias por compartir su experiencia en  Meliá Habana. Leer sus palabras nos llena de orgullo y, al mismo tiempo, nos recuerda el popósito más profundo de nuestro trabajo: hacer que cada huésped sienta que regresa a casa.

Hasta su próximo regreso, que esperamos sea muy pronto. Saludos.
